trap.label: phrasal verb
trap.wrong: I came across of an old photo.
trap.right: I came across an old photo.
trap.why: Phrasal verbs inseparáveis não levam of. Come across = encontrar por acaso; come up with = bolar; come down to = resumir-se a.

mcq.q: We need to come up **___** a plan.

fix.wrong: She came up a great idea.
fix.right: She came up with a great idea.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “I come across an old photo.”
rewrite.answer: I came across an old photo.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “We come up with a plan.”
rewrite.answer: We came up with a plan.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “She came up with an idea.”
rewrite.answer: She didn’t come up with an idea.
